documents.title: Notice Of The 41St Annual General Meeting Scheduled To Be Held On Wednesday, 30Th September, 2026 Through Video Conferencing, Other Audio-Visual Means (OAVM)
Listing Approval From BSE Limited & National Stock Exchange Of India Limited For 15,01,434 Equity Shares Of Rs 2/- Each Under Preferential Basis.

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported a turnover of over 700 crores for Q1 FY27, with sales volumes of 5,200 tons and value-added product share at 63%. Management noted that early-quarter disruptions from trade routes impacted volumes in April and May, but June saw a strong recovery with 2,200 tons dispatched. The company is restructuring its copper business into a new wholly-owned subsidiary named Tieramet Limited, and plans 40 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28. Management maintained its annual volume growth guidance at 12% to 15% and expects EBITDA margins to stay between 5% and 5.5% for the year. Bhagyanagar India Limited reported its Q1FY27 financial results, with revenue from operations at Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain full-year EBITDA margins between 5% and 5.5%.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: Export contribution for the year is estimated to be between 12% and 15%.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: So, see, the copper prices are out of our control. At 15% volume growth, you can do the reverse math based on the copper prices to see when we achieve it. But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching 5,000 crores in revenue by the year 2030, representing a 25% CAGR.
guidance.quote: Our top line projection, as in earlier, this thing, has been project... we are aiming for 3,000 crores in the year 2030. That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030. We are, in 5 years, we are planning to... 3 years, and we are planning to double the turnover to 5,000 crores, which translates in Between 20% to 25% CAGR. 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: The company is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth of 20% along with a 5% increase in prices out of the projected 25% target.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices. Between 15% to 20% should be our volume growth minimum every year.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase its value-added products share up to 66% by the end of next year.
guidance.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

demand_outlook.claim: India is highlighted as one of the fastest growing copper users, with consumption projected to reach 2.4 million metric tons by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: As we can see, India is actually one of the fastest growing copper users in the world, with around 2.4 million metric tons projected to be consumed in India by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: Secondary copper demand in India is expected to double in the next 5 years, moving from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: Out of this, if you look at the secondary copper demand, it is expected to double in the next 5 years, from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: The recycled copper market is estimated by some reports to grow at a CAGR of about 12% to 13% in India.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycled copper market, by some estimates, should be growing in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.

demand_outlook.claim: The transition from primary to recycled copper in India is accelerating due to growing sustainability focus and supply constraints.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.

demand_outlook.claim: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in copper consumption will mainly be driven by electric vehicles, automotive, power and electrification, and renewable energy.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth will mainly be driven by three sectors, EV and automotive. Because, EV requires a lot more copper than regular cars, power and electrification is also a big growth factor, and renewable energy.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's dependence on scrap from the Gulf region is less than 5%.
demand_outlook.quote: We are dependent on scrap from Gulf to less than 5% of our material comes from Gulf.

demand_outlook.claim: Management foresees a big shortage of primary copper coming after 3 or 4 years.
demand_outlook.quote: The availability, while right now there is no shortage for the next 2 or 3 years for copper. But we foresee a big shortage coming after 3 or 4 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Management has proposed a capex of 40 crores over the next 2 years covering FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has finished adding a capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is now online.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity expansion from 35,000 to 45,000 tons is projected for next financial year, more likely in June next year.
capex_expansion.quote: So, this has been projected for the next financial year. The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year. From 35,000 to 45,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently undergoing capacity expansion.
The company has proposed a capex of 40 crores over the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling.
capex_expansion.quote: right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

margins_costs.claim: The company's margins are more stable in percentage terms because raw material purchases and sales are linked to LME.
margins_costs.quote: So, our margins are going to be more stable in percentage terms than in rupees per kilo terms.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA margin for Q1FY27 stood at 5.43%.
The company's value addition per kilogram was 116 INR in Q1FY27.
The company's EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards.

margins_costs.claim: In quarter four, the company achieved an EBITDA of around 62 rupees per kg.
margins_costs.quote: With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

margins_costs.claim: Silver and tin-bearing bus bars for data centers give roughly about 10% EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: So, we are, this product will give us roughly about 10%, EBITDA margins. And this go for AI data centers and other data centers all over the world.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes for the quarter reached 5,278 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Our sales volumes have dropped, though; they have gone to 5,278 tons, which is a 9.5% decrease from the last quarter and a 6.5% decrease from last year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company exported more than 100 tons of bus bars to North America in the last quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: In the last quarter itself, we have exported more than 100 tons of bus bars to North America and we are also exporting a lot of transformer products all over the world.

orders_capacity.claim: For CTC wires, capacity is roughly 80 metric tons a month and is targeted to go up to 150 metric tons a month.
orders_capacity.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

orders_capacity.claim: The company recorded a sales volume of 5,278 metric tonnes in Q1FY27.
The company's capacity reached 35,000 metric tonnes this year with a new 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.
orders_capacity.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper sales volume grew by 34% to 24,000 metric tonnes last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The second tranche of fund raising is projected to occur around March after the demerger is completed.
capital_allocation.quote: The second tranche will probably be around March, after the demerger is done, in the standalone copper unit.

capital_allocation.claim: Long-term projections indicate debt will be between 300 and 350 crores in 2030.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our projection is showing that between 300 and 350 crores will be our debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised 52.25 crore Rupees through a preferential issue to non-promoters.
The increase in total equity from 207 crores to 257 crores was done entirely through retained earnings without dilution.
capital_allocation.quote: And then from 207 to 257. And this increase in equity was not done through dilution, this was all done through retained earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital increased from 157 crores to 230 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are looking at a fundraise. We are still not, come up with a final proposal, but we are looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade route disruptions and material shortages in the first two months caused turnover and volumes to drop initially.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's performance is subject to risks such as competition and the performance of the Indian and international economies.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the Company's ability to successfully implement its strategy

risks_headwinds.claim: Copper scrap from the Gulf region experienced short lead times and sudden supply drying up due to regional situations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up.

risks_headwinds.claim: Shipping lines carrying materials from the rest of the world have been diverted, causing delays.
risks_headwinds.quote: And, the material which is coming from the rest of the world, the shipping lines have been diverted because a lot of shipping lines have a transit point in Dubai or somewhere in the Gulf before coming to India. That has got delayed.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to execute 40 crores of capex over FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to complete a full digital transformation of the company over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching 5,000 crores in revenue by the year 2030.
management_commitments.quote: That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030. We are, in 5 years, we are planning to... 3 years, and we are planning to double the turnover to 5,000 crores

management_commitments.claim: Management proposes 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to complete a fundraise of roughly 150 crores in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We hope to do it in this financial year, definitely.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
